summary: PayPal integration testing complete - 23/23 backend tests passed, frontend PayPal buttons working correctly. Fixed a race condition bug where PayPalButtons rendered before PayPalScriptProvider was ready.

test_credentials.note: Demo user is on Pro tier

seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created during testing for clean state verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayPal integration fully tested. Backend: PayPal config endpoint (no auth), create-order (auth required, validates plan/billing), capture-order (returns 502 for unapproved orders), status endpoint (returns provider='paypal' for PayPal transactions). Idempotent tier upgrade verified - when payment_status='paid' in DB, capture-order upgrades user's subscription_tier. Frontend: PayPal buttons render in Pro and Studio cards with 'OR PAY WITH' label. Buttons disabled when user is already on that tier. Fixed race condition where PayPalButtons rendered before PayPalScriptProvider was ready.

config: No auth required for config endpoint
create_order: POST /api/payments/paypal/create-order for Pro monthly returns order_id, amount=4.99
POST /api/payments/paypal/create-order for Pro yearly returns amount=44.99
POST /api/payments/paypal/create-order for Studio monthly returns amount=12.99
POST /api/payments/paypal/create-order for Studio yearly returns amount=119.99
payment_status: GET /api/payments/status/{order_id} for PayPal tx returns provider='paypal'
idempotent_tier_upgrade: When payment_status='paid' in DB, capture-order upgrades user to Pro tier
When payment_status='paid' in DB, capture-order upgrades user to Studio tier
db_verification: create-order inserts payment_transactions row with provider='paypal', payment_status='pending'

pricing_page: PayPal buttons render in Pro and Studio cards (yellow/gold)
'OR PAY WITH' label visible above PayPal buttons
PayPal iframes load correctly (2 for unauthenticated, 1 for Pro user)
PayPal disabled message shows when user is on that tier
Stripe CTA buttons still present above PayPal buttons
